new_integration_decision.finding: Pinned test uses multiprocessing.get_context('spawn'); parent monkeypatches are not inherited. Pinned runner imports atomic_write_json directly from storage, so monkeypatching storage.atomic_write_json alone does not intercept runner.run_once writes. A witnessed A/APPENDER/B test must patch runner.atomic_write_json inside the importable child A target, after child import and before runner.run_once; child B must remain unpatched. This fixes a concrete harness-implementation trap without asserting a reproduced production defect.
no_network_contract: At exact SHA in disposable checkout, use importable top-level child targets, ctx=get_context('spawn'), shared tmp_path and T=1700000000000; seed no observations; rowB from pinned sequential fixture.

Inside child A, patch runner.atomic_write_json locally, forwarding all paths except anata_latest.json; for that file, emit A_PAUSED immediately before original writer and wait on release_A Event with timeout; use try/finally to restore alias. Parent monkeypatch does not work with spawn.

Start A, await A_PAUSED; start independent APPENDER and B. Require durable rowB archive witness, then require B_PUBLISHED_ROW_B witness plus parent read of persisted anata_latest.json with rowB before release_A. Only a positively witnessed B-before-A interleaving can test stale overwrite; missing witness = INCONCLUSIVE.

Release A and bound Queue/Event waits and process joins/termination; if rowB disappears from persisted anata_latest.json after A completes, classify RED stale handoff. Run recovery C to classify recoverable vs persistent loss, keeping RED even if recovery restores rowB.

If a future whole-run lock genuinely serializes B, require positive lock/phase evidence and post-release B rowB persistence for SERIALIZED_PASS; merely slow B or timed-out B is INCONCLUSIVE, not PASS.
Capture process exitcodes, phase timestamps, before/after archive and handoff hashes, stdout/stderr, diff-check output; never claim 3-file transaction atomicity absent consumer contract.
